_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/faces/test_turn_face_up.py. t_tfu_op_flip is Showstopping Surprise's 'Turn it face up if it's face down' on a target creature you control, without the damage half. t_tfu_op_mastery is Ugin's Mastery's 'you may turn a face-down creature you control face up' as a one-shot sorcery. t_tfu_megamorpher is a megamorph creature, so a test can show the counter comes only with paying the megamorph cost.

cards.name: Test Face-Up Flip
cards.oracle_text: Choose target creature you control. Turn it face up if it's face down.

cards.name: Test Face-Up Mastery
cards.oracle_text: You may turn a face-down creature you control face up.

cards.name: Test Megamorphing Beast
cards.oracle_text: Megamorph {2}{G} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its megamorph cost and put a +1/+1 counter on it.)
